purpose: Requirements for the agenda record layer that stores discussion items and their states as a single source of truth, so humans keep an overview while AI spends minimal effort maintaining records.
summary: Purpose and rationale: reduce AI output and reading effort spent on record upkeep
Terminology: agenda item, agenda, record, presentation, caller; the word triage is not used
Scope: record storage, state transition checks, input/output, location, count, lifetime, discarding old records
FNC-004/005: AI generates only judgment content; input is one structured handoff of a single value
FNC-006/008: operations returning next item, empty fields, remaining count; machine-readable transition preconditions
FNC-009: values received from callers (record count, identification, lifetime, severity key, state vocabulary)
FNC-010/012/013: discard legacy records; structural validity judgment before item transitions; change tracking
NFR: storage format with its own value boundaries, derived location/lifetime, testability, no secrets, visible failures
Open items TBD-003, TBD-004, TBD-006 with resolutions
tasks: Designing or implementing the agenda record mechanism
Defining record storage format or state transition rules
Writing unit tests for the agenda mechanism
title: REQ-019 議事記録機構 要件定義書
